CONSENT.HEADING: Informed Consent Form for Participation in the Experiment
CONSENT.RESEARCH_TITLE: Productivity and Beyond: Cognitive Effects of Working with Artificial Intelligence
CONSENT.RESEARCH_TEAM: Andrej Katin, Nebojša Taušan, Vladimir Mandić - University of Novi Sad
CONSENT.SECTION1_TEXT: The aim of this experiment is to examine how the use of AI-assisted tools affects cognitive load, thinking style, and the evaluation of professional tasks among software developers. Your participation helps us understand the interaction between humans and AI systems in the domain of software engineering.
CONSENT.SECTION2_INTRO: Participation in the research involves a single experimental session lasting 45 to 60 minutes. The session will take place in a controlled laboratory at the Faculty of Technical Sciences in Novi Sad.
CONSENT.SECTION2_TASK_TEXT: You will be presented with professional tasks related to evaluating legacy code (e.g. reviewing Pull Requests), which you will solve using a simulated AI assistant.
CONSENT.SECTION2_MEASURE_TEXT: While completing the tasks, an EEG device (electroencephalograph) will be used to record the electrical activity of your brain (brainwaves). In addition, you will be asked to fill out short self-assessment questionnaires.
CONSENT.SECTION2_EEG_TEXT: EEG is a non-invasive and completely safe method. It is placed on the scalp and causes no pain.
CONSENT.SECTION3_TITLE: 3. Voluntary Participation and Right to Withdraw
CONSENT.SECTION3_P2: You have the full right to stop the experiment at any time, without any explanation, and without any negative consequences for you.
CONSENT.SECTION3_P3: If you withdraw, all data collected up to that point will be deleted.
CONSENT.SECTION4_P1: All data collected during the research will be treated as strictly confidential and used exclusively for academic and research purposes.
CONSENT.SECTION4_P2: Your first name, last name, and contact information will be kept separate from the experimental data.
CONSENT.SECTION4_P3: Your individual results will not be published; only group-level, anonymized data will be used in publications.
CONSENT.SECTION5_TEXT: For any questions or concerns regarding the research, you may contact us at: beyondai.researchgroup@gmail.com
CONSENT.CHECKBOX_LABEL: I have read and understood the information provided above, and I voluntarily agree to participate in this research.
